summary.title: Welcome to Rands Leadership Slack
summary.one_liner: The Rands Leadership Slack is a community workspace of about 30k leaders, joined by an emailed, hand-reviewed request process.
takeaways: The Rands Leadership Slack is a community of over 30k members (as of late 2025) for longtime, new, and aspiring leaders.
Joining requires emailing from a long-term email account with your name, occupation, reason for joining, how you heard about it, acceptance of the Code of Conduct, and a link proving you are human.
Invitations are handled by hand, with responses typically within 24 hours.
Applicants can request a different invite address by stating it in ALL CAPS in the first line of the email.
A Rands leadership newsletter and three classic Rands articles are offered as additional reading.
summary.summary: This page is the join page for the Rands Leadership Slack, a workspace run by Rands (the author of Rands in Repose) for leaders to learn through conversation and shared ideas. It explains that membership is by manual invitation: prospective members email the owner with specified details and a link to a public profile to show they are human. The page also links to three classic Rands articles and a low-volume leadership newsletter. It is a short, process-focused page with no pricing or technical content.
